title: 第139章 战争之子又回来了
slug: 我在战锤抽词条帝皇站起来了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

原体把大魔来来回回锤了四百多回合，上边被打的仇现在都报了回来。

说不定基里曼也挺小肚鸡肠的。

冲击波把周围的岩壳震得跟碎饼干似的，从交战中心向外放射状蔓延出来的裂缝最远的已经快延伸到极限战士的阵线脚下了。

这种级别战斗的速度已经完全超出了正常人类的视觉捕捉范围，林恩只能靠战术预演的沙盘辅助才能勉强看清楚局势。

基里曼明显已经稳住了局面。

清除了混沌剧毒之后再上一个全属性翻倍，摄政王现在打起来的气势跟毒素未清除之前判若两人。

林恩感觉有点可惜。

刚才把武器附魔给一连和三连了，武器附魔有CD，现在没法用了，不然他还可以把帝皇之剑给增幅200%，那现在的场面一定很好看。

但是现在其实也够用了。

基里曼因为一直在肘击自己的亚空间本质，所以会比其他兄弟在实战表现中弱一些。

但也仅仅就是弱一些而已。

清除了余毒，又增幅百分百。

战争之子又回来了！

蓝色光点再次与红色光点撞在一起，这次碰撞之后红色光点向后狼狈地退了至少五步的距离，然后又被蓝色光点打上去，再次后退。

黑暗帝王！基里曼！

老十三在伪经线里能直接抢掉恐虐四分之三的权柄。

这才是奥特拉玛之主嘛！

卡班哈的咆哮声从远处传来，比刚才少了几分嚣张，多了几分暴怒和不信。

可惜，真可惜。

武器附魔还在CD。

现在距离上次释放大概过了四十分钟左右，还差二十分钟才能好。

如果武器附魔现在能用，基里曼手里的帝皇之剑再加一层200%的恶魔真伤。

嗐，那根本就不用打这么长时间，一刀结束战斗。

帝皇之剑本身就有恒燃圣焰，破魔属性。

帝皇亲手铸造的武器，基础面板高到离谱。

再往上再叠一层百分之二百的恶魔真伤，基里曼一剑砍下去，剑锋上的圣焰会变成三倍粗三倍亮，砍在卡班哈身上直接从伤害升级成概念抹除，卡班哈挨一刀可能就真的跟这个宇宙说再见，哪还容得着它在这放肆？

林恩还是忍不住砸了一下嘴。

“啧。”

以后得想办法把武器附魔的CD消掉，有CD的技能还是太不爽了。

决斗战场上胜负的天平已经彻底倾斜。

从基里曼的旧伤消失的那一瞬间起，这场大魔和原体战斗的走向就变得跟卡班哈预想的完全不一样。

有名有姓的大魔也打不过挂壁。

基里曼把卡班哈打得连连败退，交战点从初始的平原一路退到了西北方的一片高地。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The original body hammered the big demon back and forth for more than 400 rounds, and now all the revenge was avenged.

Maybe Guilliman is quite a bitch too.

The shock wave shook the surrounding rock shells like crackers, and the cracks that spread radially from the center of the battle almost reached the feet of the Ultramarines' front.

The speed of this level of battle has completely exceeded the range of normal human vision. Linn can only barely see the situation clearly with the help of a tactical rehearsal sandbox.

Guilliman had clearly stabilized the situation.

After clearing away the Chaos Poison, and then doubling all attributes, the Regent's fighting momentum is completely different from before the poison was removed.

Linn felt a little pity.

He just enchanted the weapons to the first and third companies. The weapon enchantment has a CD, but it can't be used now. Otherwise, he could increase the power of the Emperor's Sword by 200%, and the current scene must be very beautiful.

But it’s actually enough now.

Because Guilliman has been elbowing his subspace nature, he will be weaker than the other brothers in actual combat performance.

But it's just weaker.

The residual poison was eliminated and the power increased by 100%.

The children of war are back!

The blue light point collided with the red light point again. After this collision, the red light point retreated awkwardly for at least five steps, and then was hit by the blue light point and retreated again.

Dark Emperor!Guilliman!

Old Thirteen can directly take away three-quarters of Khorne's power in the apocryphal line.

This is the Lord of Ultramar!

Kabanha's roar came from a distance, a little less arrogant than before, and a little more furious and unbelieving.

What a pity. What a pity.

Weapon enchantments are still on CD.

It's been about forty minutes since the last release, and there's still twenty minutes left before I'm ready.

If weapon enchantment is now available, the Emperor's Sword in Guilliman's hand will have an additional layer of 200% demonic true damage.

Well, then there is no need to fight for such a long time. The battle can be ended with one blow.

The Emperor's Sword itself has the properties of eternal burning holy flame and demon-breaking properties.

Weapons forged by the Emperor himself, the basic panels are ridiculously high.

Add another layer of 200% demonic real damage on top, and Guilliman slashes it with his sword. The holy flame on the blade will become three times thicker and three times brighter. The slash on Ka'banha will directly upgrade from damage to concept erasure. Ka'banha may really say goodbye to this universe with one knife. How can it be tolerated here?

Linn still couldn't help but smacked his mouth.

"Tsk."

In the future, I have to find a way to eliminate the CD of weapon enchantment. It is still too uncomfortable to have skills with CD.

The balance of victory and defeat on the duel battlefield has been completely tilted.

From the moment Guilliman's old injury disappeared, the battle between the Daemon and the Primarch turned out to be completely different from what Ka'banha expected.

Even the famous devil can't defeat the hanging wall.

Guilliman defeated Kabanha and retreated continuously. The battle point retreated from the initial plain to a highland in the northwest.
